# CRW-894 fix round 2: the finding of the independent verifier on 5d41d266 (python3 -m json.tool imports a json module the
# same text writes: a compiled extension, a copy tree, a redirection, or a writer the reader does not model).
# CRW-894 fix round 3: python3 -m json.tool is refused as on dev (the working directory heads its module search path and json.tool imports
# many standard modules through it, so no text proves what runs). A row that expected the module allowed records the deviation.

=== CRW-894-vr-01 | U

x
--cmd
cp evil.so json.so; printf '{}' | python3 -m json.tool
